Advertisement View all journals Saved research Search Account Log in Content Explore content About the journal Publish with us Subscribe Sign up for alerts RSS feed nature nature water comments article Comment Published: 10 November 2026 Stricter wastewater regulations challenge accession to the European Union Nikola Rakonjac ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0002-0206-5233 1 , Phoebe Koundouri ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0001-5979-6128 2 , 3 , Slobodan Djordjević ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0003-1682-1383 4 , Zarko Sretenović 5 & … Dragan Savić ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0001-9567-9041 4 , 6 Show authors Nature Water ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research 37 Accesses Metrics details The latest directive from the European Union (EU) on the treatment of urban wastewater brings in stricter regulations intended to drive progress towards the United Nations’ sustainability goals, but also heightens the barriers to EU accession for many candidate countries. However, with the right support, this compliance challenge can be reframed as an opportunity to accelerate progress and strengthen environmental governance, not only for accession candidates but also for the existing EU and its neighbours.
